$comment: GitHub Actions OIDC allowlist. Each entry is either an org (owner + owner_id) or a single repository (repository + repository_id). Matching uses the numeric ids, which never change and cannot be re-registered; names are for humans. When adding an entry, set the id to null: CI (tools/check_allowlist.py) prints the right value. Optional: new_url_quota_per_day (default 500). See README 'GitHub OIDC'.
